t: Titan TTB805CHR 18V Li-Ion TXP battery charger provides efficient power delivery for trade professionals. Designed for rapid charging of Titan TXP 18V batteries, ensuring minimal downtime on busy construction sites or in workshops. Delivers a 4.0A charging current, which recharges 2.0Ah batteries in 30 minutes and 5.0Ah batteries in 75 minutes. Featuring a clear LED indicator, users can easily monitor charging status. The versatile single-port charger can be wall mounted or used freestanding, operating on a standard 220-240V power supply.
b: Compatible With Any TITAN 18V TXP Battery
LED Indicator Shows Clear Charging Status
Single-Port Design For Dedicated Battery Charging
Wall Mount & Freestanding For Versatile Placement
